candidate_definitions.frame_l2_mean: L2-normalize each speech frame, then arithmetic mean
candidate_definitions.mean: 512D mean of Task09B speech-masked pre-encoder frames
candidate_definitions.mean_norm_utterance_proto: L2-normalize each utterance mean before averaging enrollment utterances; one prototype
candidate_definitions.mean_std: 1024D concatenated per-dimension mean and standard deviation; Task09B control
candidate_definitions.median: dimension-wise temporal median over speech-masked frames
candidate_definitions.train_whiten_mean: training-speaker-only 512D covariance whitening; 10% diagonal shrinkage and 0.1% ridge
candidate_definitions.train_zscore_mean: training-speaker-only per-dimension standardization; 1e-4 scale floor and +/-8 clip
candidate_definitions.trimmed_mean: dimension-wise 10% trimmed temporal mean over speech-masked frames

protocol.evaluation: one global selected pooling method evaluated once on the 30 evaluation speakers per fold
protocol.method_selection: global method chosen only by mean balanced speaker-macro open-set accuracy on the 15 model-selection speakers per fold; known acceptance and unknown rejection receive equal weight
protocol.normalization_fit_role: 50 training speakers per fold; no selection, calibration, or evaluation identity contributes to fitted transforms within its fold
protocol.paired_queries: up to four same-source-utterance mic1/mic2 pairs; query clips are not treated as independent trials
protocol.thresholds: per-method, per-enrollment-mic, per-query-mic thresholds fitted only on the 15 calibration speakers, using leave-one-identity-out maximum impostor scores

uncertainty_note: speaker-cluster bootstrap intervals are within fold; identities recur across folds and pooled counts are not independent trials
